source:
@@U00500@@
The poor boy’s waited too long;
we can't send him away disconsolate.
Here now, give me your cap and gown.
Yes, this disguise will suit me well.

@@U00501@@
(He puts them on.)

@@U00502@@
Just trust to my wits, won't you?
I'll only be a quarter of an hour.
In the meantime,
prepare yourself for our Grand Tour.

@@U00503@@
(Exit 浮士德.)

@@U00504@@
And so it goes.
But keep it up, you sorry son of earth.
Go on, go,
go on scorning knowledge and reason,
those highest of man’s powers;
let the Spirit of Lies seduce you
with his ravishing necromancy, let him blind you
with his magic arts of illusion and deceit,
and then [’ll have you,
and no escape.
Fate endows him, this 浮士德, this striver,
with a spirit that won't desist,
a mind that refuses to know defeat,
and in his overhasty headlong struggle
he overleaps the earth, its joys, its pleasures.
But I'll have him yet.
I'll drag him through a riotous life
of numbing insignificance. I'll make him
flounder, stiffen, stick fast in my lime.
I'll dangle food and drink before his
greedy and insatiable lips and he'll
beg for refreshment,
but it will do him no good.
translation:
@@U00500@@
这个可怜的男孩等得太久了；
我们不能让他伤心地离开。
现在，把你的帽子和礼服给我。
是的，这个伪装很适合我。

@@U00501@@
（他把它们戴上。）

@@U00502@@
相信我的智慧，好吗？
我只待一刻钟。
与此同时，
为我们的盛大旅行做好准备。

@@U00503@@
（浮士德下。）

@@U00504@@
事情就是这样。
但请坚持下去，你这个可怜的地球之子。
走吧，走吧，
继续蔑视知识和理性，
人类最高的能力；
让谎言之灵引诱你
用他迷人的死灵术，让他致盲你
凭借他的幻术和欺骗魔法，
然后[会有你，
并且无处可逃。
命运赋予他这个浮士德，这个奋斗者，
带着永不放弃的精神，
一颗拒绝知道失败的心，
在他仓促的拼搏中
他超越了大地、大地的欢乐、大地的快乐。
但我还是会拥有他。
我会拖着他过放荡的生活
麻木的微不足道。我会让他
比目鱼，变硬，紧紧地粘在我的石灰里。
我会在他面前悬挂食物和饮料
贪得无厌的嘴唇，他会
请求茶点，
但这对他没有好处。
